title: settings: a stored value or secret whose manifest option/key was removed is shown blank and can never be cleared (seen with knowledge `ragflow`)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZmwqAVSYHM1nQUDTq

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · from PR #37477 (#37004) Acceptance notes, measurement (a) · Area: o5-A

## What happens
Measured on PR #37477's head `d3692d0c` after the `ragflow` option and its `ragflow_*` keys leave `knowledge.manifest.ts`, for an environment that had saved them:
1. The stored `adapter = ragflow` is served as stored; the Console Adapter select renders an empty trigger (no label, no placeholder), so the admin cannot tell what is configured (jsdom render of the real `SettingsField`).
2. The stored `ragflow_api_key` row and its `sys_secret` row stay. Every settings door now answers `400 UNKNOWN_KEY` for a `ragflow_*` key, so no door can clear the secret. `.changeset/33933-knowledge-settings-with-service.md` still says clearing the key from Setup removes it; PR #37477's changeset records that this is no longer true.

The mechanism is general: any manifest option or key removed later leaves the same residue.

## Done when
A stored value outside the manifest's current option set renders as a named "no longer available" state, and a stored key/secret the manifest no longer declares can be cleared (or is purged by a defined path) — with tests for both. The route (Console fallback vs a settings-service cleanup door vs an upgrade step) is the lane's call.

reach: every environment that saved the RAGFlow adapter before #37004; read from PR #37477's measurement.
Business reason: an admin sees a blank adapter and cannot remove a leftover credential.
Reader: triage → `domain:server` (service-settings) with a `domain:ui` half for the select.
Dedupe: `settings stored value removed option`, `orphan secret settings manifest` (open and closed) → none.
Grading: area:ai · Bug · suggested p2 · evidence: measured on PR head.
